slots.name: state legislatures
slots.sentence: The constitutional changes were swiftly approved this week by a majority of Mexico's 32 state legislatures, backed by Morena lawmakers and their coalition after passing both chambers of the national Congress.

slots.sentence: The United States allows dual citizens to become president, but the issue has proven politically sensitive.

slots.name: approval status
slots.sentence: A Mexican constitutional reform to require presidential candidates to renounce any dual citizenships is fast-tracking toward final approval

slots.name: effective date
slots.sentence: The requirement would take effect for prospective candidates in 2028, meaning it would not affect current state governors or candidates competing in the 2027 midterms.
